name: Renovate

lifecycle.note: The official 44.132.2 tag and digest were read from GHCR. The portless manual recipe imports an owner-issued Forgejo token into a private environment file and bundles only a separately approved version probe. Ordinary apply never runs it. No forge endpoint, repository scope, update run, scheduler, or remote-token acceptance is implied.

security: A Forgejo deployment requires a dedicated Renovate account and user-created Personal Access Token with the documented repository permissions; setup cannot safely generate or infer that token.
Scope repository and registry tokens to the minimum required access, and pass them only at the job's secret boundary.
pitfalls: The open-source image needs an external cron-like scheduler; a continuously running Compose service is not the documented execution model.
Repository selection and token permissions require an explicit operator choice before scheduling any update job.
RENOVATE_TOKEN is documented, but a generic RENOVATE_TOKEN_FILE input is not established here; do not fabricate a file variable or put a Personal Access Token in process arguments.
An image update PR does not prove migration or restore compatibility.
